name: list2cart
description: Turn shopping decisions from a conversation into a shareable List2Cart shopping list.

interface.longDescription: Turn a meal plan or event you discussed into a List2Cart shopping list, then share its URL with family or housemates. Add items to a list, review its items, assignees, budget and remaining days, or extend a registered list by 5, 10, 15, or 30 days. The service is free and requires no account or login. The MCP tools do not buy products or process payments. Only list names, item names, quantities, scene, extension days and the list URL are sent to List2Cart; your conversation transcript is not sent. Anyone with the list URL can access the list. The List2Cart website may display Amazon Associates links; any purchase takes place on Amazon.
defaultPrompt: Make a shopping list from the items we decided to buy, and share it with my family.
Add these items to my List2Cart list: [paste the list URL].
Show me what's on this List2Cart list: [paste the list URL].

prompts: Make a shopping list for a curry dinner for four people.
Add milk and two packs of eggs to this List2Cart list: [paste the list URL].
How many days are left on this List2Cart list? [paste the list URL].

positive.description: Core workflow: create a shareable list from agreed shopping items. No account or login is needed.
positive.prompt: Make a shopping list for a curry dinner for four people: one box of curry roux, two onions, three potatoes, two carrots, and 400 g of chicken.
positive.tools_triggered: Call create_shopping_list with a concise curry-dinner list name and items matching the five requested products and quantities. Treat 400 g as part of the chicken item name and quantity 1.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the URL from the tool response and a concise list of the created items. The response must not claim registration or 30-day activation; explain that opening the URL and starting the list registers it if relevant. Do not send the conversation transcript.

positive.description: Input variation: create a picnic list with a theme, explicit quantities, and an item whose quantity is omitted. No account or login is needed.
positive.prompt: Create a picnic shopping list with three bottles of tea, four apples, and sandwiches.
positive.tools_triggered: Call create_shopping_list with a picnic list name, theme set to picnic, tea quantity 3, apples quantity 4, and sandwiches with quantity omitted or 1.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the created list URL and report the requested items and quantities, including one sandwich item when quantity defaults to 1. Do not invent additional purchases.

positive.description: Add items to an existing list. Setup: in the same conversation, create a temporary test list with create_shopping_list and use its returned URL in this prompt.
positive.prompt: Add one carton of milk and two packs of eggs to this List2Cart list: [paste the test list URL].
positive.tools_triggered: Call add_shopping_list_items with list set to the exact user-provided List2Cart URL and items milk quantity 1 and eggs quantity 2.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirm only the items the tool reports as added. Preserve the quantities and do not claim the list was changed if the tool returns an error.

positive.description: Read a temporary list and report its registered status. Setup: create the test list in this conversation with create_shopping_list, add milk and eggs with add_shopping_list_items, and use its returned temporary-list URL.
positive.prompt: What items are on this List2Cart list, and has its 30-day period started? [paste the test list URL].
positive.tools_triggered: Call get_shopping_list with list set to the exact user-provided List2Cart URL.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the returned items and status. For a temporary list with no expiry or days_left, explain that the 30-day period has not started and avoid inventing an expiry.

positive.description: Extend a registered test list once. Setup: create a test list with create_shopping_list, open its returned URL in a browser, press “Start shopping list” to register it, then use that URL here. No account or login is needed.
positive.prompt: Extend this registered List2Cart list by five days: [paste the eligible test list URL].
positive.tools_triggered: After the user explicitly requests the extension, call extend_shopping_list with list set to the exact URL and days set to 5.
positive.expected_behavior: Report success and the new expiry only if returned by the tool. Extend once per test; the expiry cannot exceed 60 days from today, so do not claim a repeated extension succeeded if the tool returns the maximum-expiry error.

negative.description: Purchasing and checkout are outside the plugin's capabilities. The assistant must explain this limit and must not invoke a List2Cart tool or imply that an order was placed.
negative.prompt: Buy the groceries on my List2Cart list and check out using my saved payment method.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that List2Cart can manage a shopping list but cannot place orders or process payments. Do not claim a purchase or checkout occurred.

negative.description: The plugin can read returned assignee and budget information but cannot assign items or configure a budget. The assistant must not call a tool to perform these unsupported changes.
negative.prompt: Assign the milk to Aiko and set the list budget to 3,000 yen: [paste a List2Cart URL].
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that assignments and budgets can be changed on the List2Cart website, while the MCP tools can only read those values. Do not say the requested changes were applied.

negative.description: Store discovery and price comparison are outside the plugin's capabilities. The assistant must not fabricate current prices or invoke list-management tools for this request.
negative.prompt: Find the cheapest supermarket near me for the items on my shopping list.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that List2Cart does not search stores or compare live prices. Do not invent a store, location, price, or availability.

review.commerce_description: The MCP tools do not support purchases, orders, or payments; they only manage shopping-list data. Separately, the List2Cart website may display Amazon Associates product links. Any purchase happens on Amazon, and List2Cart may earn a commission from qualifying purchases.

publication.release_notes: Initial OpenAI submission package for the existing List2Cart MCP workflows, with corrected listing metadata, public links, icon, review prompts, and test cases.

ja-JP.subtitle: 会話から共有できる買い物リスト
ja-JP.description: 献立やイベントの会話から List2Cart の買い物リストを作成し、URL で家族や同居人と共有できます。リストへの商品追加、内容・担当者・予算・残り日数の確認、本登録したリストの期限延長に対応します。無料で使え、アカウントやログインは不要です。MCP ツールから商品の購入や決済はできません。List2Cart のウェブサイトには Amazon アソシエイトの商品リンクが表示される場合があり、購入は Amazon 上で行われます。会話の記録は送られず、リスト名・商品名・個数・シーン・延長日数・リスト URL のみを扱います。リスト URL を知っている人はリストにアクセスできます。
